info.title: WANX Octop · teams
info.description:
**CentaurAI-WANX** is a smarter, self-hosted AI assistant for multiple users and agents. All routes are served under `/api`.

## Authentication

Most endpoints require a JWT bearer token:

1. Complete initial setup via `/api/setup/*` (first install only).
2. `GET /api/auth/captcha` then `POST /api/auth/login` with `username` and `password`
   (and `captcha_token` when a strong provider is active), or complete SSO with
   `/api/auth/oidc/*` or `/api/auth/oauth/*` when a provider is enabled.
3. Send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` on subsequent requests.

Access tokens use sliding renewal: when less than one-third of
`access_token_ttl_seconds` remains, authenticated responses may include a fresh
token in the `X-Octop-Access-Token` header. Clients should replace the stored
token when present.

Public endpoints (no login token): `/api/docs`, `/api/openapi.json`, `/api/health`,
`/api/setup/*` (wizard authorization applies), `/api/auth/login`, `/api/auth/register`,
`/api/auth/captcha`, `/api/auth/oidc/status`, `/api/auth/oidc/start`,
`/api/auth/oidc/callback`, `/api/auth/oidc/exchange`, `/api/auth/oauth/status`,
`/api/auth/oauth/start`, `/api/auth/oauth/callback`, `/api/auth/oauth/exchange`,
`/api/auth/invite/validate`,
`/api/auth/invite/redeem`, `/api/connectors/oauth/callback`,
and `/api/internal/mcp/*`.

## Agent scope

Many agent-scoped routes use the agent ID in the URL path (`/api/agents/{agent_id}/…`).
Routes first check the signed token's application scope; legacy tokens default to WANX.
Resources in another application are treated as not found, including for administrators.
Within the same application, each route applies its ownership or shared-resource access
rules. WANX administrators may bypass ownership where supported; Zhijun personal profiles,
memories and uploaded sources require the owner.

## Streaming chat

Dashboard live turns use **WebSocket** at `/api/agents/{agent_id}/chat/ws` (pass JWT as
`?token=` query param). Send `{"type":"user_turn", ...}` frames; the server replies with JSON
chunks matching the harness stream format, ending with `{"type":"done"}` or
`{"type":"error","message":"..."}`.

Text-type dashboard pushes (cron reminders, proactive care) also emit
`{"type":"dashboard_push", ...}` on `/api/notifications/ws` (same `?token=` auth) so the
SPA can show a toast even when the chat socket is not subscribed.

HITL resume still uses `POST /api/agents/{agent_id}/chat/hitl/resume` (SSE).

## Knowledge libraries

`/api/knowledge-bases` uses the signed application scope for creation, visibility,
document access, and citations. Existing libraries remain in WANX. Zhijun libraries
are private to their owner and use local document parsers, downloaded native ONNX
embeddings and RapidOCR. Remote WANX embedding/OCR settings do not affect Zhijun;
missing local components are reported as unavailable without remote fallback.

get.summary: Get my advisory roster and WANX expert catalog

post.summary: Initialize or configure my advisory team
post.description: Selects two to twelve expert templates from WANX and optionally assigns each an enabled WANX chat model. Reuses private native Agents and histories. Rejects unknown, disabled or embedding models and changes during active discussions. Provider settings and host deployment bindings remain managed by WANX.

post.summary: Import a SkillHub expert template into the WANX catalog
post.description: Uses WANX's existing SkillHub package installer. Imported experts can then be selected for the user's private advisory roster; this does not publish or change other agents.

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api Brainstorm Sessions Get

post.summary: Open a user-centered meeting with the host
post.description: Retrieves owned Zhijun context and begins a short intake conversation. Advisors cannot be dispatched until the user confirms the proposed agenda.

get.summary: Get my brainstorming state and sources

get.description: Available after closure. Uses the frozen meeting findings and explicit owner ruling. Older closed meetings are compiled on first read. Ownership and application authorization are required.

get.summary: Export my final meeting report as an editable Word document
get.description: Renders the same frozen report as a genuine DOCX. Requires ownership and active application authorization; does not rerun agents or adopt recommendations.

post.summary: Respond, confirm the agenda or control my meeting
post.description: Text and decision-card selections share the respond action. Start requires the current agenda decision ID; selections require the current decision ID and option index. Revision rejects stale submissions. Adoption records the user's ruling and closes the meeting. Pause blocks future dispatches; in-flight results remain in history. Source changes pause and affect future context without retracting previous inputs.

decision.description: The current owner input card; its id changes when replaced.

ruling.title: Ruling
ruling.description: An explicit owner adoption, never a host summary.

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: Only adopt on a verdict records the owner's final ruling.

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: Frozen report including the explicit owner ruling, if any.

expert_models.title: Expert Models
expert_models.description: Model assignments keyed by selected WANX expert ID. Values must be enabled chat models from the current WANX catalog. Omitted experts keep their existing model.

text.title: Text
text.description: Owner feedback for respond. Use either text or option_index.

decision_id.title: Decision Id
decision_id.description: Current card id, required for selecting an option or starting.

option_index.title: Option Index
option_index.description: Zero-based index in the current card's options.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Last observed revision; stale submissions are rejected.
